description: Boundary coverage for the opt-in enable-marker selector. Adds the case where the enable marker field is entirely omitted (no marker object at all), which is treated as absent and therefore rejected, and a mixed batch covering present-true (admit), present-false (admit, value irrelevant), explicitly-absent (reject) and omitted (reject) in a single input-ordered run. Output lists each candidate as its name and whether it was admitted.

cases.expected_output:
container=pt included=true
container=pf included=true
container=absent included=false
container=omitted included=false
